description: Adds a custom claim. Custom claims apply across the configuration. Claims targeting access tokens also apply to client-credentials tokens. A custom roles claim can give roles to clients without their own roles. claim: { name, value: string|number|boolean|string[], target?: both|id_token|access_token }.

claim.description: The custom claim. Custom claims apply across the configuration. Claims targeting access tokens also apply to client-credentials tokens. A custom roles claim can give roles to clients without their own roles.

name.description: The claim name. Required when adding; fixed afterwards.

value.description: The claim value: a string, number, boolean or array of strings, stored and emitted with that JSON type. Omitted or null: the empty string when adding, the stored value when editing.

configuration_id.description: The configuration id (from create_tenant or get_tenant).

name: add_custom_claim
